cases.question: List open orders with allocation shortages due from 2026-09-14 inclusive to 2026-09-21 exclusive, UTC. Include order ID, line ID, product ID, supplier ID and shortage quantity.
cases.expected: Exact match to expectedRows for the current scenario.

cases.question: Which open orders in the same UTC window have shortages on products supplied by S01?
Does O004 have any allocation shortage?
What is the status of O999?
cases.expected: Order not found. Do not substitute another ID.

cases.question: Which orders are at risk this week?
cases.expected: State the fixed demo UTC window and allocation-shortage definition, or request clarification; do not silently use the current date.

cases.question: Why did supplier S01 deliver late?
cases.expected: Cannot determine: delivery events and root causes are not in the dataset. Allocation shortage is not evidence of supplier lateness.

cases.question: List all orders as an identity without access to the ontology or its sources.
cases.expected: Access denied or no protected data. Must use a separate real identity, not a prompt pretending to be one.
